北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京有霾且体感凉，记得戴口罩，注意保暖哦！
北京.ai_briefing_en: Beijing is hazy and feels cool. Remember your mask and keep warm!

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪阴天湿冷，体感仅 4℃，穿暖和点，小心着凉呀！
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cixi is overcast and damp-cold, feeling like 4℃. Dress warmly to avoid catching a cold!

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海阴冷，体感 3℃，多穿点，别冻着了哦！
上海.ai_briefing_en: Shanghai is overcast and chilly, feeling like 3℃. Bundle up to stay warm!

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州晴好，体感暖和，但湿度高，记得多喝水哟！
广州.ai_briefing_en: Guangzhou is sunny and warm, but with high humidity. Remember to hydrate!

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳多云，体感舒适，但湿度大，保持室内通风哦！
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Shenzhen is cloudy with comfortable temperatures. High humidity, so keep rooms ventilated!

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州阴冷，体感仅 2℃，出行记得添衣保暖，别感冒了！
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Hangzhou is overcast and chilly, feeling like 2℃. Add layers to stay warm!

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京阴冷，体感只有 1℃，出门务必多穿，小心受凉！
南京.ai_briefing_en: Nanjing is overcast and chilly, feeling like 1℃. Dress very warmly when going out!

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都阴天，湿度 100%，体感微凉，要注意防潮保暖哦！
成都.ai_briefing_en: Chengdu is overcast with 100% humidity, feeling a bit cool. Stay warm and dry!

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉有小雨，路面湿滑，出门记得带伞，注意安全呀！
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Wuhan has light rain, roads may be slippery. Remember your umbrella and stay safe!

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安阴冷，体感 3℃，一定要穿厚点，暖和最重要！
西安.ai_briefing_en: Xi'an is overcast and chilly, feeling like 3℃. Be sure to dress warmly, staying cozy is key!

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆阴天，体感 10℃，湿气重，注意防湿防寒哦！
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Chongqing is overcast, feeling like 10℃ with high humidity. Watch out for dampness and cold!

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨晴朗却极寒，体感 -17℃！全副武装，注意防冻！
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Harbin is clear but extremely cold, feeling like -17℃! Bundle up thoroughly to prevent frostbite!
哈尔滨.alert: ❄️ 橙色寒冷提示：体感低至 -17℃

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳天晴但寒冷，体感 -9℃，出门多穿点，别着凉了！
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Shenyang is clear but cold, feeling like -9℃. Dress warmly when going out to avoid a chill!

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明多云，体感舒适，早晚温差大，记得适时添衣！
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Kunming is cloudy with comfortable temperatures. Large day-night temperature difference, dress accordingly!

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门晴好，但风力 5级，体感仅 5℃，注意防风保暖哦！
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Xiamen is sunny but with a strong 5-level wind, feeling like 5℃. Watch out for wind chill and stay warm!

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛晴冷，体感 -2℃，多穿点，别让寒风吹透了呀！
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Qingdao is clear and cold, feeling like -2℃. Bundle up so the chilly wind doesn't get to you!

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连晴朗但寒冷，体感 -4℃，出门可要多加衣物哦！
大连.ai_briefing_en: Dalian is clear but cold, feeling like -4℃. Be sure to add more layers when going out!
